final.answer: ELEN2017A is Electric Circuits (12 NQF credits, approximately 120 total notional learning hours). It is taken as EFA03 Year 2 compulsory; EFA04 Year 2 compulsory. Academic staff/lecturer(s): Prof Ivan Hofsajer; Mr Mohammed Dangor. Course coordinator: Prof Ivan Hofsajer. Content covered: Introductory electric circuit analysis using current voltage resistance differential equations and complex numbers; structured as the Circuit Gym. Source: verified 2026 CBO.

course_information.additional_materials: Circuit Gym study guide; Ulwazi; scheduled laboratories.
course_information.evidence_notes: Total notional hours are calculated as credits multiplied by 10.

hours.basis: 1 NQF credit represents 10 notional learning hours; explicit weekly guidance is quoted separately from the available course evidence.
hours.contact_pattern: Two Wednesday periods and one Thursday period plus Monday or Friday afternoon laboratories.
hours.weekly_workload_guidance: No explicit weekly workload stated in the CBO.

course_information.lecturer: Prof Ivan Hofsajer; Mr Mohammed Dangor
course_information.prescribed_materials: James W. Nilsson and Susan A. Riedel - Electric Circuits - Global 11th edition - Pearson; other editions accepted.
course_information.scope: Introductory electric circuit analysis using current voltage resistance differential equations and complex numbers; structured as the Circuit Gym.
